senses.def: something that is hard to understand or explain
senses.ex: How the money disappeared is still a mystery.
senses.exPt: Como o dinheiro sumiu ainda é um mistério.

senses.def: to make someone confused because they cannot understand something
senses.ex: His strange behaviour mystified all his friends.
senses.exPt: O comportamento estranho dele intrigava todos os amigos.

senses.def: an old traditional story, or an idea many people believe that is false
senses.ex: It's a myth that you lose most heat through your head.
senses.exPt: É um mito que você perde a maior parte do calor pela cabeça.

senses.def: existing in or connected with ancient myths
senses.ex: The unicorn is a mythological creature with a single horn.
senses.exPt: O unicórnio é uma criatura mitológica com um único chifre.

senses.def: the ancient stories of a culture about gods and heroes
senses.ex: My son loves reading about Greek mythology.
senses.exPt: Meu filho adora ler sobre mitologia grega.
